title: Cancellation Notice and the Missed Functional Capacity Evaluation Fee
content:
# Cancellation notice and the missed-evaluation fee

Functional Capacity Evaluation appointments of a Workers' Compensation Referral are booked in the Appointment Series funded by the referral, and cancellations reach the clinic through that Appointment Series with the notice recorded in hours.

**Notice rule.** The notice share comes from the latest cancellation of an evaluation appointment in the appointment series funded by the referral: none of the fee where it reached the clinic twenty-four (24) or more hours before the appointment, half of the fee (0.5) where it reached the clinic twelve to twenty-three (12 to 23) hours before, and the whole fee otherwise, a no-show included.

| Notice recorded on the latest cancellation in the funded Appointment Series | Share of the fee |
|---|---|
| 24 hours or more | none |
| 12 to 23 hours | one half |
| fewer than 12 hours | the whole fee |
| no cancellation — a no-show | the whole fee |

## Edges

- 23 hours of notice: one half. 24 hours: none.
- 11 hours: the whole fee. 12 hours: one half.

## Case (hypothetical)

The latest cancellation in the funded Appointment Series reached the clinic 14 hours before the evaluation. The share is one half: a fee of $300.00 at this stage becomes $150.00.
